markers.name: Sam
says: Sam> "Hey, there. Take a load off. What can I get you?"
Sam> "No, I just serve the drinks. Have you ever heard of a Screaming Viking?"
Sam> "Sailing is a big passion of mine. But my boat sank, so I have to do something."

markers.name: Mobodo
says: Mobodo> "Get down with your bad self!"
Mobodo> "I"m saying it... that"s right... keep dancin"... all night..."
Mobodo> "Watch this one, up and left and right and crossover, yeah!"

markers.name: Berri
says: Berri> "Keep it up and we can dance all night. Isn"t that what life is about?"
Berri> "I actually have a good day job. But I haven"t been to work in three weeks. I hope I"m still employed."
Berri> "I am going to need a drink soon, but this is my favorite song!"

markers.name: Royder - Trendor Guard
says: Royder> "Keep it real."
Royder> "Just act responsibly, and we"ll all have a good time."
Royder> "No murderers allowed."

markers.name: Hayden - Trendor Guard
says: Hayden> "Just guarding the money."
Hayden> "Every once in a while, I get an itch to... to... well, never mind."
Hayden> "Not much happens around here. Not sure I like that."

markers.name: Lissa - Trendor Guard
says: Lissa> "Nope, not much happening here."
Lissa> "Just guarding the bank. Nobody would dare mess with me and my partner."
Lissa> "The invasion is just a blip on my radar. Over and done with. Can"t even remember what they looked like."

markers.name: Bevel - Trendor Guard
says: Bevel> "Take your business to the store. I"m just a guard."
Bevel> "I fear nothing. I dread nothing. I sense nothing. Wait..."
Bevel> "Listen to that sound... is it rain?"

markers.name: Jo - Trendor Guard
says: Jo> "Be careful. I can"t protect you if you go in there."
Jo> "It"s condemned for a reason."
Jo> "Overrun by monsters and we haven"t gotten around to clearing them out."

markers.name: Penelope - Trendor Guard
says: Penelope> "What a great assignment. Isn"t it peaceful here?"
Penelope> "I can just breathe deep and enjoy the park. Just don"t cause any trouble and we will be fine."
Penelope> "Yes, there was an invasion. We had enough, came back and drove them all out. It was sweet."

markers.name: Xtx Hover Bike
says: The Xtx Hover Bike is our fastest model ever! Sleek styling combined with precision handling add up to superior performance.
The latest Hover Sonic Engine in the Xtx delivers over 850 Ean Factors of raw torque while the new and improved Sonic Thrusters make acceleration delay a thing of the past.
The Xtx goes from 0 to its top speed of 250 factors per hour in .001 seconds, making it the fastest mode of transportation on the planet!

markers.name: Jxi Hydro Craft
says: Immerse yourself in the perfect blend of luxury and watersport - the Jxi Hydro Craft.
The Jxi single-passenger personal watercraft is sleek, stylish and affordable.
Its fission-tempered hull can withstand the most acidic liquids as well as most energy weapons, making body work virtually a non-factor.

markers.name: Jester
says: Jester: "Wanna know why Celeste was so sad last week? She was engaged to this guy with a wooden leg, but she had to break it off."
Jester: "These two Vigons are rolling along and one asks the other, "Hey, are we poisonous?" The other says, "I dunno. Why?" "Because I just bit my lip." Hahahahaha!"
Jester: "What is the capital of Boomtown? B, of course."
